product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green

product.name: Marsh Cesspool Cesspit Tank
product.description:
The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.
Please note, whoever empties your cesspool should be a registered Waste Carrier and hold a current discharge licence from the local water authority.

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Pumped Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.
product.variant_name: Marsh Portapura 2 Person Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant - Pumped

product.name: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description: The Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant comes with lifting eyes to make unloading and installation faster and safer. product.name: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant is an effective solution for sewage treatment, designed to accommodate areas where a natural gravity flow is not feasible. By opting for a pumped treatment plant, the system will efficiently direct effluent to higher levels, ensuring an economical and environmentally friendly operation.
When installed correctly, the Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant operates virtually odour-free and near-silently, also offering a discreet design that will not create eyesores in your garden or outdoor spaces. It is recommended Ensign plants are positioned at a minimum distance of seven metres from a dwelling or ten metres from a stream.
Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantAn effective and environmentally friendly pumped solution for sewage treatment in areas without gravity flowEfficiently directs effluent to higher levels using a pumpDiscrete design, virtually odour-free and operates near-silentlyFeatures lifting eyes for easy unloading and self-levelling on the base for easy installationUnique pipe connections for efficient and cost-effective installationTreats effluent to British and European Standards25-year structural guarantee
Featuring lifting eyes, this treatment plant facilitates quick and safe unloading, while its self-levelling capability on the base ensures ease of installation. The unique and innovative pipe connections enable efficient and cost-effective installation, catering to various property sizes.
The Ensign range of sewage treatment plants excels in treating final effluent to both British and European Standards, meeting national consent standards for discharge into watercourses. Manufactured with 100% virgin resin, excluding chalk fillers, this plant prioritises sustainability. It has undergone rigorous testing, adhering to the highest European testing standard, EN12566:3-2005, enabling direct discharge to ditches, watercourses, or percolation beds.
Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 12566 3-2005
Please note: External Cabinet as standard. Fitted with an internal pumped outlet and will do a max head of 3m and 50m pumped distance. Outlet is 32mm MDPE.

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.
product.variant_name: Marsh:Standard Sewage Treatment Plant - 200 People

product.name: Sky Garden Firebreak Riverstone Border
product.description:
Sky Garden's riverstones are ideal for the perimeter of any green roof. These stones facilitate efficient drainage, ensuring water flows freely off the roof, while giving the system a clean, crisp finish. This natural composition ensures durability and long-lasting performance, making it a perfect choice for green roof perimeters.

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Y Unequal Branch for Surface Water Drainage
product.description: Designed to create a branch from a surface water drainage main line at a 45° angle, JFC Manufacturing's Twinwall drain pipe Y unequal branch is a triple socket section manufactured from HDPE plastic. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process, which means having two layers simultaneously extruded, a strong and durable structure is assured. The process is performed once inside and the other heat welded together in a continuous process. The outer wall is also corrugated for exceptional strength, reducing the potential for on-site damage to occur. As opposed to the inner wall which is smooth with a seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. Better yet, the modern design means that unlike traditional single-wall pipes it will prevent slit accumulation. Features & Benefits: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Y Unequal Branch for Surface Water DrainageLightweight for easy handling and transportation on-siteCan be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metresTwin walled and corrugated for strong structureSmooth inner wall supports increased flow capacityCan be combined with a full range of bends of all angles and both equal and unequal junctions are also availableResistant to naturally occurring chemicalsPlant and labour cost reductionEliminates waste compared to traditional pipesEasy to cut to length if requiredThe branch complies with HAPAS Roads and Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069, is BBA approved and, if installed correctly with three sealing rings, a watertight system is achievable. If it is too long, you can also cut the branch as needed to fit accordingly. Please note: Suitable for surface water drainage only.

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe for Surface Water Drainage - 6000mm
product.description: Available in a range of diameters and with or without perforations to suit your installation needs, this JFC CorriPipe™ offers the perfect solution for effective surface drainage. Manufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) plastic, this Twinwall Drainage Pipe is a product of precision manufacturing.Through a cutting-edge twin extrusion process, two layers seamlessly intertwine and are heat welded together in a single continuous step, ensuring durability and reliability. The outer layer boasts a corrugated design, enhancing its structural integrity and reducing the risk of on-site damage. Meanwhile, the inner wall features a smooth, seamless finish that optimises hydraulic flow, eliminating the headache of silt accumulation that plagues traditional single-wall pipes.Features & Benefits: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe for Surface Water Drainage - 6000mmFor surface water drainageManufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) plasticInnovative twin extrusion process ensure durabilityCorrugated outer wall for added structural strengthSmooth inner wall for optimal hydraulic flow and no silt buildupLightweight with a generous 6-metre length for easy installationReduces labour and plant costs with fewer jointsResistant to a wide range of naturally occurring chemicalsSuitable for various soil conditions (depths from 0.5 to 10 metres*)Thanks to its lightweight construction and generous length of 6 metres, this product facilitates a swift and hassle-free installation process. This not only saves you time but also minimises labour and plant costs due to fewer required joints. Plus, its resistance to a wide range of naturally occurring chemicals makes it suitable for various soil conditions. A full range of fittings and accessories are also readily available to complete your drainage system.Please note: *The maximum cover depths for CorriPipe™ are typically between 6 and 10 metres when installed in accordance with series 500 of the MCDHW Volume 1 as detailed in the CorriPipe™ BBA certificate.

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Surface Water Drainage Double Socket Bend
product.description:
HDPE double socket twinwall bends. For use with twinwall pipe to create a rigid bends. If installed with 2 sealing rings a watertight system can be achieved.
For surface water applications only. Complies with HAPAS BBA.
Twin Wall drainage pipe is made from HDPE plastic and is available from 100mm to 3000mm diameters. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process in which two layers are simultaneously extruded, one inside the other and heat welded together in one continuous process. The outer wall is corrugated providing excellent structural strength which reduces the possibility of on-site damage. The inner wall has a smooth seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. This design, unlike traditional single-wall pipe prevents silt accumulation.
Benefits of Twin Wall include:

Lightweight 6 metre long lengths
Strong (Twin Walled & corrugated)
Smooth inner wall for increased flow capacity
Resistant to naturally occuring chemicals
Can be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metres
BBA and HAPAS Roads & Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069
Reduced plant & labour costs
Faster installation as 6 metre lengths mean fewer joints
Elimination of waste compared to traditional pipe
Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site
A full range of bends of all angles & both equal & unequal junctions are also available
product.variant_name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe 15 Degree Double Socket Bend - 150mm

product.name: Naylor Pre-Loaded Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description:
The specially knit fabric allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe that are subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with the water. The remaining larger soil particles that are blocked from passing through the fabric, bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. Like granular backfill materials, the bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials immediately surrounding the perforated drainage pipe. It is particularly suited for use in sandy and silty soil conditions.

Screens out sand & sediment
No need For special backfill

product.description:

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. These particles, unable to pass through the fabric, create a bridging effect on its outer surface. This not only provides additional structural support but also enhances the permeability of the surrounding native backfill materials, mimicking the benefits of granular backfill. This geotextile is especially well-suited for sand and silty soil conditions. product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Rafter Bracket
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. When it comes to creating beautiful, environmentally friendly and maintenance free buildings, using the right materials is everything. product.name: Lindab 190mm Half Round Steel Adjustable Fascia Bracket
product.description:
This extended 240mm fascia bracket is ideal for larger 190mm gutters while using flexible metal clips at the front and back to secure them in place while fixed to fascia boards for a straightforward and effortless assembly process. With four screw holes, this bracket offers a more secure fixing for a reliable guttering installation.From Lindab’s innovative steel painted Rainline guttering range, this bracket has been built to last, made from strong steel with a protective layer of thick, 275g per square metre of zinc which galvanises the surface to produce a non-corrodible material. product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Drain Shoe
product.description: This drain shoe can be used to connect a downpipe directly to a ground drainpipe with the drain shoe fitting on the outside of the downpipe, the drain shoe cover sits over the drainpipe. Quick and easy to install by simply pushing the pipes together, this drain shoe is ideal for commercial or domestic properties.With minimal maintenance requirements, this drain shoe can be lifted to provide maintenance access, is recommended to be cleaned annually and requires the occasional top-up with paint for any scratches. This drain shoe is lightweight, long-lasting and robust, manufactured from superior galvanised steel. With a protective thick layer of 275g per square metre of zinc and a painted top coating of coloured polymer grains, this drain shoe has excellent flexibility, scratch resistance and corrosion resistance.Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Drain Shoe Variety of colours and downpipe diameters to choose from  Superior galvanised steel material  Suitable for small or large, classic or contemporary buildings  Resistant to discolouration and UV stable with high-build polyester powder coating  Resistant to corrosion and vandalism  Low maintenance needs  Cost-effective and affordable  Minimal environmental impact  Long-life with minimal thermal movementAvailable in a range of colours and diameters to match your downpipes, this drain shoe is protected with an extra-durable high-build polyester powder coating which extends its life expectancy to an excess of 7NULL years.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Universal Bracket
product.description:
This universal pipe bracket can be used for fixing downpipes to the wall with screw fixes and SST spike drive-in fixes. In 1.5m interval spacing the bracket clicks into place over the downpipe, compatible with all Lindab Rainline pipes.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
Lindab steel guttering can be fitted to new builds and refurbishments to offer a subtle and light-coloured guttering system that isn’t obtrusive or distracting from the overall aesthetic of the property. With a 70-year life expectancy, HB polyester painted guttering won’t split, leak, shrink or fade and the 275g layer of zinc that this steel guttering is coated in won’t discolour or rust.
Extremely low maintenance, Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering is modern and inexpensive, perfect for homeowners who need longevity and durability from their guttering system without the hassle of constant maintenance. This system only needs the occasional wipe down. The steel guttering itself is made from galvanized steel guttering, coated in zinc for extra durability, and the HB polyester paint is warrantied for 15 years. To ensure safety and security this HB polyester painted steel guttering can be fit flush to walls so people can’t use it to scale up buildings.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Conical Bend
product.description:
Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

Available in 3 metre continuous lengths and in three diameters (100mm, 125mm and 150mm), Leafline is easy to install. Simply place one or more in your guttering; they even bend around corners. No special tools or training are required and it only takes a matter of minutes. The leafline gutter brush is virtually indestructible, made of stainless steel wire core with polypropylene bristles, so it will be years before you have to think about this problem again.
Features

Prevents leaves and debris build-up in guttering.
Stops birds and rodents entering loft spaces.
Easily fitted in minutes, even around corners.
Virtually indestructible and maintenance free.
Suitable for most domestic gutters.
Cost-effective.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset
product.description:
The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Rectangular Galvanised Steel Regular Water Hopper
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System

product.name: Lindab Airy AIRYB Vent Valve (Body Only)
product.description: Designed for wall or ceiling installation in new-builds or as an upgrade replacement, the Airy AIRYB Vent Valve by Lindab helps improve your indoor climate. It features a smart grip function which ensures easy installation, plus unique sound performance that ensures optimum sound level. The valve consists of two parts, the valve body (AIRYB) and the flat front plate (AIRYFP - sold separately). It's a slim, effective air valve with unlimited applications and has the lowest sound power level on the market. To install, fix the valve body to the duct system or a valve socket via flexible spring wings. The front plate is then attached to the valve body via springs. In addition to their design, size variations are available to ensure you have the right one for your project requirements. product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. The pipes are coated with a primer (minimum thickness of 40 µm) on their exteriors and an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). These epoxy coatings mean that pipes and fittings will only require minimal maintenance during their service life.High in tensile strength and non-combustible to prevent the need for fire protection collars, Harmer SML stands as a cutting-edge cast iron technology, with BBA certification, full compliance with BS EN 877, Kitemark certification, and CE Mark conformity.Standards & CertificationMeets British and European Standards: BS EN 877 and BS EN 14366; 2004 for excellent noise attenuationCertification: BBA Agrément certifiedCE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013Kitemark Certification: in accordance with BS EN877

Easy to install and made from durable cast iron for recyclability after use, this branch provides resistance to accidental external damage and vandalism for a long-lasting solution.The complete soil and waste pipework system boasts secure connections through twin screw couplings crafted from ductile and stainless steel, alongside socketless fixing between pipes and fittings, for effortless assembly free of specialised installation equipment. product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Bellmouth Gully
product.description:
Harmer SML is a lightweight, dry jointed pipework system at the leading edge of cast iron technology. BBA Agrément Certified and fully compliant with BS EN 877, Kitemark certification and with CE Mark conformity, this proven system has more than 30 years' use throughout Europe.
Applications

A complete soil and waste pipework system
Covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection
Also suited to rainwater installations in conjunction with Harmer Roof Outlets
Pipes available in standard 3m lengths, in diameters of 50mm to 400mm
Choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings

Installation & Fixing

Assembled by means of twin screw couplings
Secure socketless fixing between pipe and fitting
No special installation equipment required
Epoxy coatings ensure pipes and fittings need minimal maintenance over lifetime of installation

Performance

Agrément certified and meets European Standard BS EN 877
CE Mark: European product conformity to harmonised standard BS EN 877 in accordance with Construction Products Regulation 2013
Kitemark Certification in accordance with BS EN877
Lightweight, strong and durable
Excellent noise attenuation, tested to BS EN 14366: 2004
Non-combustible - fire protection collars not necessary
High tensile strength
Inherent resistance to external accidental damage and vandalism
Quick to assemble
100% recyclable

Materials & Finishes

Pipes and fittings manufactured in grey iron to DIN 1691  (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15)
Couplings are manufactured in stainless steel and ductile cast iron
Pipes exterior have a primer coat, minimum thickness 40 µm
Pipes interior have an epoxy coating with a minimum thickness of 120 µm
Fittings are coated externally and internally with an epoxy coating, minimum thickness 60 µm

product.name: ACO C-Line Shower & Wet Room Channel Drain Grating
product.description:
The ShowerDrain C series is characterised by modern design and perfect functionality. The basic is the high quality stainless steel which is used for the production of the shower channel itself, gully and grating. The foul air trap is made out of polypropylene. The steel parts are passivated; the gratings are brushed to the silk gloss. From the user's point of view the ACO ShowerDrain C excelled especially by the high flow rate, very low construction height and very easy maintenance.

50mm Outlet
High Flow Rate 0.9l/s
Channel Supplied with Grating

Low Construction Height
The standard model of ACO ShowerDrain C 50 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has a construction height only 92 mm. The lowered model (30 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has incredible construction height of only 65 mm. If integrated foul air trap not needed, it is possible to install ACO ShowerDrain C only with the spigot. In this case, the construction height is equal to the height of the channel only 18 mm. These values enable very wide application of ACO ShowerDrain C in the modern new buildings and buildings under reconstruction.Easy maintenance
The user´s comfort is increased by the efficiency of the foul air trap and its easy cleaning. Syphon (foul air trap) is made out of plastics. The reliable seal is injection-moulded together with the foul air trap. Due to this construction, there is no risk of losing of the sealing, or another malfunction. The foul air trap can be easily removed from the shower channel. It is easy to disassemble it into two separate parts and clean it by hand or in a dish washer.

The ShowerDrain C series is characterised by modern design and perfect functionality. The basic is the high quality stainless steel which is used for the production of the shower channel itself, gully and grating. The foul air trap is made out of polypropylene. The steel parts are passivated; the gratings are brushed to the silk gloss. From the user's point of view the ACO ShowerDrain C excelled especially by the high flow rate, very low construction height and very easy maintenance.

50mm Outlet
High Flow Rate 0.9l/s
Channel Supplied with Grating

Low Construction Height
The standard model of ACO ShowerDrain C 50 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has a construction height only 92 mm. The lowered model (30 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has incredible construction height of only 65 mm. If integrated foul air trap not needed, it is possible to install ACO ShowerDrain C only with the spigot. In this case, the construction height is equal to the height of the channel only 18 mm. These values enable very wide application of ACO ShowerDrain C in the modern new buildings and buildings under reconstruction.Easy maintenance
The user´s comfort is increased by the efficiency of the foul air trap and its easy cleaning. Syphon (foul air trap) is made out of plastics. The reliable seal is injection-moulded together with the foul air trap. Due to this construction, there is no risk of losing of the sealing, or another malfunction. The foul air trap can be easily removed from the shower channel. It is easy to disassemble it into two separate parts and clean it by hand or in a dish washer.

product.description:
With a modern, functional and minimalistic design, wetrooms offer an innovative alternative to the standard enclosed shower tray, and are becoming the must-have in contemporary bathroom design. They particularly appeal to those with an eager passion for following design and fashion trends, offering the potential to convert a cramped bathroom into a more accessible, luxurious and spacious wetroom, which allows users to shower in safety, comfort and style.
Wetrooms represent an innovative and sophisticated method of designing and building space efficient areas in all types of buildings, from domestic properties and hotels through to leisure facilities and hospitals. Equally critical, is the fact that they provide a simple means of adhering to current legislation to ensure ease of access to all members of the community. Using the latest developments in drainage technology and installation methods, it is easier to convert, refurbish or construct new showering and bathing areas than ever before.
Austenitic stainless steel linear drainage channels with clean lines that characterise today's trends in bathroom design. 
For large shower areas and for multiple showers application use ACO Modular 125 as an alternative solution.

product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Adjustable Shallow Channel
product.description: The FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system from ACO. Combining line drainage with point drainage using an open-sided drainage channel, this system collects and conveys rainwater to drainage points within raised or suspended deck structures. Rainwater interception happens at three points, including surface run-off, percolation within the deck and rainwater outlet positions. To ensure you can rely on the product's quality, the channel complies with national access regulations. Manufactured from galvanised steel, this adjustable shallow channel is installed directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Where pavings are required to be laid 'open or closed joint', an efficient drainage solution is created. This improves safety for foot traffic and weathered protection of the building fabric.Features & Benefits: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Adjustable Shallow ChannelSuitable for all types of suspended deck constructionDetails into all types of flat roof finishesPractical withing all applications during building lifeProtects and maintains building fabricEngland and Wales Building Regulations ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDING: Approved Document M compliantScottish Building Standards DOMESTIC AND NON DOMESTIC HANDBOOK: Section 4 compliantNorthern Ireland Building Regulations, DFP Technical Booklet R: 2006 ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDINGS: Section 7 compliant

product.name: ACO HygieneFirst 304 Stainless Steel Kitchen Tray Slip Resistant Ladder Grate
product.description:
ACO’s HygieneFirst drainage systems fulfils the stringent hygienic requirements to minimise harmful bacteria and pathogen contamination of food arising from the drainage elements.
This is done by applying relevant hygiene design principles reserved for food contact surfaces by the implementation of BS EN 1672, BS EN ISO 14159 and EHEDG Document 8 requirements to drainage element design.
ACO’s slip-resistant grates have no mesh and are fully cast or welded, and every joint is curved to make removal and cleaning an easy and safe process (without the need for inappropriate power washing). 
Features and Benefits

Manufactured from 304 grade stainless steel
Tested and certified according to BS EN 1253-1
Design enables quick and easy cleaning
Rounded corners
Hygienic design following BS EN 1672, BS EN ISO 14159 and EHEDG document No. 8, 13 and 44

product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Adjustable Deep Channel
product.description: This galvanised steel deep channel section is part of ACO's reliable and versatile 'FreeDeck' adjustable roof and balcony drainage platform. The FreeDeck range combines line and point drainage into a single system, making it a solid choice for a range of domestic drainage projects. FreeDeck uses open-sided drainage channels to collect and convey rainwater towards drainage points within raised or suspended deck structures at surface run-off, percolation and rainwater outlet positions. This unit is fully adjustable for slope, letting you install it with confidence with just a few turns of a screwdriver.With the majority of the FreeDeck system manufactured using galvanised steel or stainless steel, channels are laid directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. This system provides efficient and dependable drainage whether installed with both open or closed joint paving to improve safety for foot traffic and better protect the building. product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Slotted Grating
product.description:
ACO FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system combining line drainage with point drainage by using an open sided drainage channel system to collect and convey rainwater to drainage points within a raised or suspended deck structure.Rainwater is intercepted at 3 points:

Surface run-off
Percolation within the deck
Rainwater outlet positions

Manufactured in galvanised steel or stainless steel, ACO FreeDeck channel is simply laid directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Efficient drainage is provided where paving's are required to be laid 'open or closed joint' improving safety for foot traffic and weathered protection of the building fabric.
Complying with national access regulations, ACO FreeDeck channels provide level access drainage in compliance with:

England and Wales Building Regulations ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDING: Approved Document M
Scottish Building Standards DOMESTIC AND NON DOMESTIC HANDBOOK: Section 4
Northern Ireland Building Regulations, DFP Technical Booklet R: 2006 ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDINGS: Section 7

Key Features
ACO FreeDeck is used for rainwater drainage and safe access in a variety of applications

Drainage for all types of suspended deck construction
A system that details into all types of flat roof finishes
Practical within all applications throughout building life
A drainage system that protects and maintains the building fabric

product.name: ACO Freedeck Stainless Steel Access Frame Extension
product.description:
ACO FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system combining line drainage with point drainage by using an open sided drainage channel system to collect and convey rainwater to drainage points within a raised or suspended deck structure.
Rainwater is intercepted at 3 points:

Surface run-off
Percolation within the deck
Rainwater outlet positions

Manufactured in galvanised steel or stainless steel, ACO FreeDeck channel is simply laid directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Efficient drainage is provided where paving's are required to be laid 'open or closed joint' improving safety for foot traffic and weathered protection of the building fabric.
Complying with national access regulations, ACO FreeDeck channels provide level access drainage in compliance with:

England and Wales Building Regulations ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDING: Approved Document M
Scottish Building Standards DOMESTIC AND NON DOMESTIC HANDBOOK: Section 4
Northern Ireland Building Regulations, DFP Technical Booklet R: 2006 ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDINGS: Section 7

Key Features
ACO FreeDeck is used for rainwater drainage and safe access in a variety of applications

Drainage for all types of suspended deck construction
A system that details into all types of flat roof finishes
Practical within all applications throughout building life
A drainage system that protects and maintains the building fabric

product.name: ACO 304 Grade Stainless Steel Single Socketed Pipe Bend
product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic
product.variant_name: ACO 304 Grade Stainless Steel Single Socketed Pipe 87.5 Degree Bend - 110mm

As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic
product.variant_name: ACO Stainless Steel Pipe Increaser Coupling Concentric 110mm to 125mm
